ca13fd54266f.name: scala-cli package --assembly, java -jar
ca13fd54266f.description: Assembly jar run with the default JVM settings (G1 garbage collector). Compile time is not measured; the JIT warm-up is.

f37cfef3ec12.name: ocamlopt -O3 -unsafe
f37cfef3ec12.description: Native code without bounds checks (-unsafe); -O3 only matters on flambda compilers.
f37cfef3ec12.build: mkdir -p {bin}.o && cp {src}/main.ml {bin}.o/main.ml && cd {bin}.o && ocamlopt -O3 -unsafe -inline 200 -I +unix unix.cmxa main.ml -o {bin}

35a932a63686.name: dotnet build -c Release
35a932a63686.description: Release build, default runtime settings (tiered compilation, dynamic PGO, concurrent workstation GC).
35a932a63686.build: export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1; P={bin}.proj; mkdir -p $P && cp {src}/Program.fs $P/ && sed "s/@TFM@/net$(dotnet --version | cut -d. -f1,2)/" /repo/languages/fsharp/app.fsproj > $P/app.fsproj && cd $P && dotnet build -c Release -o {bin} -v q -nologo

0997198e31bf.name: ocamlopt
0997198e31bf.description: Native code with bounds checking (the default).
0997198e31bf.build: mkdir -p {bin}.o && cp {src}/main.ml {bin}.o/main.ml && cd {bin}.o && ocamlopt -I +unix unix.cmxa main.ml -o {bin}

84e27460c708.name: DOTNET_TieredCompilation=0
84e27460c708.description: Every method is fully optimised on its first call: slower start-up, no tier-0 phase.
84e27460c708.build: export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1; P={bin}.proj; mkdir -p $P && cp {src}/Program.fs $P/ && sed "s/@TFM@/net$(dotnet --version | cut -d. -f1,2)/" /repo/languages/fsharp/app.fsproj > $P/app.fsproj && cd $P && dotnet build -c Release -o {bin} -v q -nologo

a3931e2b9f61.name: ghc -O2 -threaded
a3931e2b9f61.description: Optimising build with the threaded runtime (needed for the parallel workload; default heap settings).

f62bea3efc88.name: Rscript
f62bea3efc88.description: Default interpreter with the bytecode compiler (JIT level 3).

f3ef848296ac.name: java -XX:+UseParallelGC -jar
f3ef848296ac.description: Throughput-oriented collector with less barrier overhead than G1.

68f5c5d68fa8.name: ghc -O2 -threaded +RTS -A64m
68f5c5d68fa8.description: Same binary, 64 MB allocation area: fewer minor collections for allocation-heavy code.

571b54fb6c86.name: elixir script.exs
571b54fb6c86.description: Default BEAM flags: one scheduler per core.

6d2e646321b3.name: nim c -d:danger
6d2e646321b3.description: Also removes bounds, overflow and nil checks (unsafe: errors are no longer detected).

a1ba11111b14.name: elixir --erl "+sbt db"
a1ba11111b14.description: Schedulers bound to cores (default binding), which can reduce migration noise for the parallel workload.

50f501557355.name: gfortran -O3 -fopenmp
50f501557355.description: Optimised build with OpenMP (needed for the parallel workload).
